name: SENTENCE-MENDS-ownNow-unhanded
old: sentenceMends(playerEntity, court.regionIndex, { from: court.from, ownNow: ownMinutes() });
why: kept as sentenceMends' one contract (both arms hand it the own clock): the prison arm reads it after advanceDays has served at least a day, and every grace that can stand then was granted before the arrest (a release, a fine, a pardon) and runs CHALLENGE_GRACE_MINUTES, one day - so no prison arm ends inside one and nothing can tell it. fb1021d_sentencemends pins the day against the grace, so the record goes stale the day a grace outlasts a sentence; the zero-day arm's read is the live one, pinned there
